Cause: a plane is only 75 words at 1M, so per-group-per-plane set-up (432 apply_group calls per pass) dominates the dense side (~40 us vs the champion whole pass 58 us); the 48-start walk costs ~200 cycles per sparse prime. Prediction (-5% to +3% at 1T) missed. Next shape, if ever: interleave the 48 planes (one 3.6 KB stripe layout) so the dense pass vectorises across planes.
